permissions.label: View tasks
permissions.description: Not used yet. Everyone already sees the tasks assigned to them.

permissions.label: Create tasks
permissions.description: Shows “Add task”: add tasks for the team, assigned to the whole team. HR works with every team; team leads and employees only with their own team.

permissions.label: Edit tasks
permissions.description: Edit task names, type and teams. HR edits every team's tasks; team leads and employees only their own team's.

permissions.label: Reassign tasks
permissions.description: Choose which employees of the team a task is assigned to, instead of the whole team.

permissions.label: Complete tasks
permissions.description: Not used yet. There is no task completion feature.

permissions.label: Archive tasks
permissions.description: Activate, deactivate and delete tasks (HR: every team; others: their own team).

permissions.label: View task timesheets
permissions.description: Not used yet.

permissions.label: Add manual timesheet entries
permissions.description: Add and delete back-filled time entries from the team timesheet. HR can add entries for every employee; team leads and employees only for the employees of their own team, never for themselves.

permissions.label: View teams
permissions.description: Not used yet.

permissions.label: Create teams
permissions.description: Create teams on the Teams page (adds Teams to the menu).

permissions.label: Edit teams
permissions.description: Rename, edit and deactivate any team (adds Teams to the menu).

permissions.label: Assign employees to teams
permissions.description: Not used yet. Team membership is changed by editing an employee.

permissions.label: Remove employees from teams
permissions.description: Not used yet. Team membership is changed by editing an employee.

permissions.label: Assign team leads
permissions.description: Assign a lead when creating a team with “Create teams”, or change an existing team's lead with “Edit teams”.

permissions.label: View team timesheets
permissions.description: Team overview, timesheets, attendance and reports. Team leads see their assigned employees; employees see the employees of their own team. HR accounts have no team, so HR uses “View all employee reports” instead.

permissions.label: View team productivity reports
permissions.description: Not used yet.

permissions.label: View clients
permissions.description: Not used yet. Client names are always listed so employees can start timers.

permissions.label: Create/edit clients
permissions.description: Add, rename and deactivate clients (adds Clients to the menu).

permissions.label: View projects
permissions.description: Not used yet. Projects are always listed so employees can start timers.

permissions.label: Create/edit projects
permissions.description: Add, edit and delete every project, including their clients and teams (adds Projects to the menu).

permissions.label: Link projects, clients and tasks
permissions.description: Open Task links to link or unlink existing tasks and project clients. Employees and team leads are limited to their own team; HR works across teams. Selection enforcement remains restricted to company task administrators.

permissions.label: Assign projects
permissions.description: Not used yet. Project teams are set with “Create/edit projects”.

permissions.label: View personal reports
permissions.description: Not used yet. Everyone can see their own timesheet.

permissions.label: View team reports
permissions.description: Not used yet. Team reports follow “View team timesheets”.

permissions.label: View all employee reports
permissions.description: Company-wide overview, timesheets, attendance and reports for every employee (adds the company reports to the menu).

permissions.label: Export Excel/PDF
permissions.description: Shows the Export Excel and Export PDF buttons. Exports are built in the browser from data the person can already see.

permissions.label: View billing amounts
permissions.description: Open the Billing page and see charge amounts for every employee.

permissions.label: Manage employee service rates
permissions.description: Not used yet. Charge rates are edited on the Employees page.

permissions.label: View financial reports
permissions.description: Not used yet.
